Could you please send us a refund for the bus ticket? Thank you for your time. Sincerely, Mia.
accepted: Dear Ms Lopez, I am writing to explain a problem with our exchange trip. Our plane arrived late, so we missed the bus. Could you please send us a refund for the bus ticket? Thank you for your time. Sincerely, Mia.

Dear Ms Lopez, I am writing to explain a problem with our exchange trip. Our plane was late, so we missed the bus. The host family had not received our message, so nobody met us and we waited for two hours. If the school had told the family, they would have waited for us at the airport. I would appreciate it if you could send us a refund for the bus ticket. Thank you for your time. Sincerely, Mia.

Dear Ms Lopez, I am writing to explain a problem with our exchange trip. Our plane arrived late, so we missed the bus. The family had not received our message, so nobody met us and we waited for two hours. If the school had warned them, they would have met us at the airport. Could you please send us a refund for the ticket? Thank you for your time. Sincerely, Mia.

feedback.es: El mensaje completo abre con Dear, cuenta lo ocurrido en pasado (arrived late, had not received), plantea la hipótesis (if + had + participio, would have met), pide con cortesía y cierra con Thank you y Sincerely.

origin.text: Datos: escribe a la Sra. López. El avión llegó tarde y perdieron el autobús. La familia anfitriona no había recibido el mensaje, así que nadie los recibió y esperaron dos horas. Hipótesis: si la escuela hubiera avisado a la familia, los habrían recibido en el aeropuerto. Pide un reembolso del billete del autobús y cierra con una despedida formal.

prompt.es: Escribe tu mensaje final: relato, deducción, mensaje transmitido y acuerdo.

answer.text: There was a misunderstanding at the airport. The host family had not received our message, so nobody met me. The address must have been wrong, because the message came back. The school told me that they would send a new message. If they had checked the address, they would have avoided the problem. I suggest that we call the family today. Do we have a deal?

origin.text: Datos: cuéntale a tu coordinador lo que pasó: la familia anfitriona no había recibido el mensaje, así que nadie te recibió en el aeropuerto.
